6406: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.
6418: Lie on your back with a band anchored and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.
6419: Lie on your back and hold the band firmly with both hands.
Lift your bent knees over your hips.
Curl your pelvis upward, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold for a moment at the top.
6423: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.
6424: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell against your chest.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
6425: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, back flat.
Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return upright.
6428: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.
6435: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
6437: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handle with your arm raised.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your arm down toward your side.
Keep your elbow straight or slightly bent.
6438: Stand beside a bench and rest one hand on it, hinging forward at the hips.
Let the other arm hang straight down, relaxed.
Swing the arm gently forward and back in a small arc using your body's motion.
Then swing it side to side and in small circles.
Keep the shoulder loose and the movement easy.
Do equal time on both sides.
6439: Stand on the band with one foot and hold the handle at your thigh, palm down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Raise the arm forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
6440: Anchor the band at about waist height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm across your body.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Sweep the arm out and slightly back to the side with a soft elbow.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap.
Complete all reps, then turn around and switch arms.
6441: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate the forearm outward, keeping the elbow pinned.
Pause when your hand points forward or slightly out.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
6442: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Bring the knee back in without touching down.
6443: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly on your hands.
Lift one leg a little off the floor.
Draw slow circles in the air with that foot.
Keep your core engaged and your torso steady.
6444: Kneel on the floor with your knees together.
Point your toes back and sit on your heels.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Lengthen your spine and breathe slowly.
6464: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
6465: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together, knees open.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
6466: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
6485: Stand tall holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
6486: Stand on a band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
